name: Ty pravda dumaesh', chto shaurmennaja − luchshee mesto dlja svidanija?
original_name: Ты правда думаешь, что шаурменная − лучшее место для свидания?
source:
Dating is a tricky thing. Everything always doesn't go according to plan... For example, someone is always late. That's what happened this time as well.

[Translated from [url=https://hatereallys.itch.io/shawa-date]Itch.io[/url]]
